one_liner: Klaviyo has a broad REST API with self-serve private API keys and self-serve OAuth app creation, free test accounts, and an official vendor-hosted MCP server.
auth_notes: Private API keys (Klaviyo-API-Key header) with scopes, and OAuth authorization code with PKCE. OAuth apps can be created at klaviyo.com/oauth/client. Public site ID is only for client endpoints. The Conversations API is gated separately (not re-verified in the provided pages).
access_notes: Klaviyo docs say there are no platform or API usage fees and a free test account can be created. The pages given do not re-verify the 250-profile free tier or the Conversations API gating; those draft details are retained at lower confidence.
blocker_notes: Marketplace listing needs partner approval, but building and testing do not. Conversations API is reportedly gated.

evidence.quote: Klaviyo provides 3 methods of authentication including private key authentication and OAuth (used to call server-side APIs) and public key authentication (used to call client-side APIs).
